metas.name: Avedon
metas.description: Richard Avedon's photographs didn't just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon's archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century.

metas.name: Free Leonard Peltier
metas.description: Leonard Peltier, an activist jailed for decades after a disputed conviction, faces his twilight years as a new generation fights for his release from prison before it's too late.

metas.name: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
metas.description: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

metas.name: Tribeca 25
metas.description: Twenty-five years after 9/11, Tribeca 25 chronicles how Robert De Niro and Jane Rosenthal transformed an ambitious effort to revive Lower Manhattan into one of the world's leading cultural institutions. Through rare archival footage, exclusive interviews and behind-the-scenes access, the film explores how art can foster community, confront injustice, and help shape culture.

metas.name: The Last Salute
metas.description: Chronicles the MiG-21's final chapter in the Indian Air Force, showcasing stories of generations of fighter pilots who flew it.

metas.name: Death of the Pastor's Wife
metas.description: What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.

metas.name: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes
metas.description: Follows cult leader Charles Manson's rise, the 1969 murders committed by the Manson Family, and the 1971 trial through unreleased prison recordings, firsthand accounts, and interviews.

metas.name: Instadocs: The Prediction Games
metas.description: Prediction markets let anyone bet on anything, from the World Cup to alien invasions. "Instadocs" investigates the explosive rise of global betting.

metas.name: A Toxic Love Story
metas.description: A string of threatening e-mails escalates into a revenge plot involving a newly-married US Marshal and his ex-girlfriend.

metas.name: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
metas.description: Never-before-seen footage and survivor accounts trace the 2012 shipwreck of a luxury cruise and the disaster that ensued, in this immersive documentary.

metas.name: The Crash
metas.description: A teen slams her car into a building, killing her boyfriend and his friend. What seems like a tragic accident becomes a murder case.

metas.name: Nemesis
metas.description: LA crime drama pits master thief Coltrane Wilder against detective Isaiah Stiles, challenging heist genre norms while examining what drives, sustains and destroys people.

metas.name: Legends
metas.description: Customs agents go undercover to infiltrate Britain's most dangerous drug gangs, following a thrilling criminal investigation based on extensive research and interviews with those involved in the top-secret operation.

metas.name: Apex
metas.description: A mountain climber haunted by a fatal decision in Norway retreats to the Australian wilderness for isolation. Her journey turns into a desperate hunt when a deceptive local targets her as his next ritualistic prey in the bush.

metas.name: Unchosen
metas.description: When a young mother from a sheltered cult crosses paths with a mysterious stranger, she embarks on a risky affair that awakens desires and dark secrets.

metas.name: The Hollywood Rabbi
metas.description: How does the child of immigrants, raised on the Lower East Side of Manhattan, become Frank Sinatra’s personal rabbi, win two Academy Awards, mingle with four kings, three popes, eight presidents and a who’s who of Hollywood royalty while dedicating his life to healing the world through tolerance?

metas.name: The Truth and Tragedy of Moriah Wilson
metas.description: An intimate, arresting portrait of cyclist Moriah Wilson—raised by a fierce, loving family—whose singular drive becomes her superpower, carrying her to athletic brilliance and, devastatingly, toward a life cut short by murder.

metas.name: The Plastic Detox
metas.description: Six couples with unexplained infertility reduce their plastic exposure to improve their chances of conceiving.

metas.name: Louis Theroux: Inside the Manosphere
metas.description: With rare access and no holds barred, the acclaimed documentarian investigates a growing ultra-masculine network and its controversial influencers.

metas.name: War Machine
metas.description: On one last grueling mission during Army Ranger training, a combat engineer must lead his unit in a fight against a giant otherworldly killing machine.

metas.name: Agatha Christie's Seven Dials
metas.description: England, 1925. At a lavish country house party, a practical joke appears to have gone horribly, murderously wrong. It will be up to the unlikeliest of sleuths—the fizzingly inquisitive Lady Eileen 'Bundle' Brent—to unravel a chilling plot that will change her life, cracking wide open the country house mystery.

metas.name: The Rip
metas.description: Trust frays when a team of Miami cops discovers millions in cash inside a run-down stash house, calling everyone — and everything — into question.

metas.name: One Last Adventure: The Making of Stranger Things 5
metas.description: An inside look at the years of effort and craft that went into the final installment of the Duffer Brothers' generation-defining series.

metas.name: HIS & HERS
metas.description: Two estranged spouses — one a detective, the other a news reporter — vie to solve a murder in which each believes the other is a prime suspect.
